en.title: Live-Action High School Family Adds 7 More Stars for Early 2027 Release
en.summary: Get ready for more chaos from the Naruse family! The upcoming live-action film adaptation of Ryo Nakama's 'High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku' has just expanded its already impressive cast with seven new additions, promising a wild ride when it hits theaters in early 2027.
en.body:
The world of **Kokosei Kazoku** is about to get a whole lot more crowded, and we couldn't be more thrilled. The highly anticipated live-action film adaptation of Ryo Nakama's quirky manga, **High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku**, has officially unveiled a wave of new cast members. This latest announcement brings the total cast count to an impressive number, hinting at a rich tapestry of characters ready to bring the absurdity of a father attending high school with his children to life.

Joining the previously announced **Masaya Kimura** as the titular high school student Seitarō Naruse, and **Miyu Honda** as Kotone Akai and **Yūka Kageyama** in an undisclosed role, are a host of familiar faces from Japanese entertainment. The new additions include **Yoshihiko Inohara**, **Onoe Matsuya**, **Shingo Yanagisawa**, and **Naoto Takenaka**, among others. While the specific roles for these new actors are still under wraps, their presence alone suggests a commitment to a star-studded production that aims to capture the heart and humor of the original manga. The film is slated for a January 8, 2027 release, giving fans plenty of time to anticipate the Naruse family's unique brand of high school drama.

## The Expanding Naruse Household

The premise of **High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku** is simple yet ripe for comedic potential: a father decides to enroll in high school alongside his children. This unconventional setup promises a wealth of awkward encounters, generational clashes, and perhaps even some surprisingly poignant moments as the family navigates adolescence together, albeit from vastly different perspectives. The growing cast suggests that the film won't just focus on Seitarō and his immediate family, but will also delve into the wider school environment and the various personalities that populate it. This expansion is crucial for a story that relies on the ensemble's chemistry and the sheer volume of comedic situations that can arise from such a premise.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans of the original manga and those who enjoy slice-of-life comedies with a unique twist, this extensive casting news is a major signal of intent. It indicates that the production is investing heavily in bringing the beloved characters to life with a talented roster. The film's release date of January 8, 2027, places it squarely in a period where audiences might be looking for something fresh and engaging after the holiday season. The success of similar genre films often hinges on strong performances and a faithful, yet cinematic, adaptation of source material. With this many actors on board, the potential for memorable character interactions and laugh-out-loud moments is incredibly high, making **High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku** one to watch.

## What's Next

With the cast now largely revealed, the focus will likely shift to promotional materials, including trailers and character posters, in the lead-up to the January 8, 2027 release. Fans can expect more details about the specific roles of the newly announced cast members to emerge as the film's premiere date draws closer.
